lightworks.headlamp.fit_hint: Craft with a %s to fit a headlamp

lightworks.hint.moving_lights_shaders: Lightworks: under a shader pack, lights on vehicles, contraptions and turning heads light the world only with LambDynamicLights or Sodium Dynamic Lights installed. This tip shows once; turn it off in Lightworks' client config.
lightworks.ponder.beam_sensor.text_1: A Beam Sensor gives a redstone signal
lightworks.ponder.beam_sensor.text_2: It turns on while a beam lands on its lens
lightworks.ponder.beam_sensor.text_3: The dimmer the beam, the weaker the signal
lightworks.ponder.beam_sensor.text_4: Dyed, it senses only beams of that colour
lightworks.ponder.beam_sensor.text_5: A red beam turns it on again
lightworks.ponder.beam_sensor.text_6: Moving and carried lights count too, but not lamps or torches
lightworks.ponder.edge_light.text_1: Edge Lights mark runways, taxiways and platforms
lightworks.ponder.edge_light.text_2: Vehicles and players pass over them
lightworks.ponder.flashlight.text_1: The Flashlight is a lamp you carry
lightworks.ponder.flashlight.text_2: Right-click to switch it on or off, in either hand
lightworks.ponder.flashlight.text_3: Crafted with a dye, its beam takes that colour
lightworks.ponder.flashlight.text_4: A water cauldron or a fan through water washes it off
lightworks.ponder.flashlight.text_5: Crafted with Engineer's Goggles or a Diving Helmet, it becomes a headlamp
lightworks.ponder.flashlight.text_6: Worn, it lights where you look, hands free
lightworks.ponder.flashlight.text_7: Press H to switch the headlamp on or off
lightworks.ponder.flashlight.text_8: Craft the headgear alone to take the Flashlight back
lightworks.ponder.floodlight.header: Lighting an area with a Floodlight
lightworks.ponder.floodlight.text_2: Mount one high and aim it down to light an area
lightworks.ponder.floodlight.text_3: It mounts on floors, walls and ceilings
lightworks.ponder.headlight.text_1: Headlights light the way ahead of a vehicle
lightworks.ponder.headlight.text_2: On the move, only those facing forward light up
lightworks.ponder.headlight.text_3: When it reverses, they swap over
lightworks.ponder.headlight.text_4: Power one with redstone before assembly to keep it lit both ways
lightworks.ponder.pan_tilt_head.header: Sweeping a light with the Pan-Tilt Head
lightworks.ponder.pan_tilt_head.text_1: A Pan-Tilt Head turns the light on top of it
lightworks.ponder.pan_tilt_head.text_2: The shaft pans it, as fast as the shaft turns
lightworks.ponder.pan_tilt_head.text_3: Redstone tilts it up: 6° per level, straight up at 15
lightworks.ponder.pan_tilt_head.text_4: Hold right-click on its box to sweep back and forth
lightworks.ponder.pan_tilt_head.text_5: Its light's Pan box turns it, and the sweep centres there
lightworks.ponder.pan_tilt_head.text_6: Stopped, the light holds its aim
lightworks.ponder.rotating_beacon.text_1: Rotating Beacons sweep two opposite beams round
lightworks.ponder.rotating_beacon.text_2: The faster the shaft, the faster the sweep
lightworks.ponder.rotating_beacon.text_3: Stopped, the beams hold still and light where they land
lightworks.ponder.searchlight.header: Lighting a spot with a Searchlight
lightworks.ponder.searchlight.text_1: Searchlights throw a long, narrow beam
lightworks.ponder.searchlight.text_2: It lights the block it lands on
lightworks.ponder.searchlight.text_3: On moving vehicles, the beam still lands where it points
lightworks.ponder.shared.aim: Hold right-click on Pan or Tilt to aim it
lightworks.ponder.shared.dye: Right-click with a dye to change its colour
lightworks.ponder.shared.redstone: Redstone dims it. A full signal turns it off
lightworks.ponder.tag.lights.description: Lights that keep working on anything Create builds
lightworks.ponder.tail_light.text_1: Tail and Brake Lights glow dim red at the back
lightworks.ponder.tail_light.text_2: They brighten for a second when the vehicle slows or stops
lightworks.ponder.tail_light.text_3: Placed in the world, they just glow
lightworks.ponder.warning_light.text_1: Warning Lights glow amber and give block light
lightworks.ponder.warning_light.text_2: Hold right-click on its box to pick a pattern
lightworks.ponder.warning_light.text_3: The lower row runs the same patterns only at night
lightworks.ponder.warning_light.text_4: Its light follows the pattern too
